items.title: 3 ETFs That Give You Johnson & Johnson In Different Doses
items.summary: You might like Johnson & Johnson for its mix of medicine and medical devices, but owning a single stock means living with its specific risks. Simply Wall St flags pressure on profit margins, with recent margins at 16.2% versus 27.2% last year. Holding Johnson & Johnson inside a fund spreads that business specific hit across many holdings, and also spreads out any gains.
